notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514034/1afcfd0dd447eab4cc7803acbaad0a7201ce8efd.jpg[/img]
Hi!
I've been actively developing a new game all these months, and it set off on its journey on November 17. It's nice that while I was doing other stuff, people from all over the world didn't forget about hexurb. The game didn't drown in the tens of thousands of other games.
Having finished with the development of the second game and fixed all the hot issues, it's finally time to pay attention to hexurb. It's not a content update, but it changes the main menu and game settings, adds new options, and fixes a number of silly bugs.

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Main menu update.
[*] Update the settings menu.
[*] Information box update.
[*] New system of saving and loading graphical settings.
[*] Added ability to disable fog.
[*] Added ability to disable cloud shadows.
[*] Added ability to instantly build block.
[*] Changed game modes.
[*] Changed the conditions for obtaining achievements.
[*] Added ability to center the camera in the game world on the X key.
[*] Fixed several bugs that caused a block not to be created.
[*] Fixed in-game camera control while in the menu.
[*] Slight rebalancing of obtained blocks.
[*] Disabled movement when the cursor is near the borders of the game window.
[*] Changed the saturation of cloud shadows.
[*] Performed a small optimization of the game resources.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514034/1afcfd0dd447eab4cc7803acbaad0a7201ce8efd.jpg[/img]
A minor update that makes the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Added edge scrolling if the mouse cursor touches the edge of the game window, as an alternative to normal movement with the WASD keys.
[*] Added the ability to turn off the fog on the Delete key.
[*] Fixed several bugs that prevented some in-game achievements.
[*] Fixed not getting building blocks under some game conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514034/1afcfd0dd447eab4cc7803acbaad0a7201ce8efd.jpg[/img]
Hello! It's time for another update.

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Added blocks with shrubs.
[*] Added blocks with nesters.
[*] Added key building needing shrubs around.
[*] Added key building, needing nesters around.
[*] Added light to building windows.
[*] Added description of game modes.
[*] Added the ability to zoom in with the PageUp and PageDown keys.
[*] Slight update of text in tutorial due to new hotkeys.
[*] Reduced chance of rare blocks dropping out.
[*] Fixed repeated dropout of a fortress in the tutorial level, which causes the inability to complete the tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue with SteamVR.
[*] Fixed the glow of the first block that is created at the beginning of the game.
[*] Small balance corrections.
[*] Small gameplay interface fixes.
[/list]
List of known bugs:
[list]
[*] Visual problem with buttons in the main menu in some non-standard game window resolutions.
[*] Lack of ability to build a block on some cells. Currently solved by double-clicking a cell instead of single-clicking it.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514034/1afcfd0dd447eab4cc7803acbaad0a7201ce8efd.jpg[/img]
Hi! It's time for the big update.
The update adds the following to the game:
[list]
[*] Creative Mode! No limits, no randomness. Make the world the way you want it to be.
[*] Customize the color scheme for the game if it seems too dark for you. 
[*] New secret blocks for regular game modes.
[*] Several new achievements.
[*] You can now rotate the active block with the R key.
[*] Slight graphical optimization.
[*] Minor UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Creative Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514034/c8f982d7aaef3cfeba7ba4741abeb6b92a40e723.jpg[/img]
Hi!
There's an update coming out soon that adds Creative Mode to the game!
Key features:
[list]
[*] no limits on the number of blocks available to build.
[*] no random blocks, everything is in your hands.
[*] extra keys for in-game actions.
[*] additional, secret objects of the game world.
[*] additional achievements. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02

notes.title: Update 1.01
